basis: Hearing loss, diabetes and optic atrophy define the main WFS1 phenotypes; expression varies, and isolated hearing-loss forms lack diabetes and optic atrophy.
Parasitic infection; damaging skin, lymphatic and ocular manifestations vary by subtype and are not established in most patients across the umbrella.
Inherited muscular dystrophy directly affects scapular and upper-arm skeletal muscles.
Vertebral and rib malformations plus defining oral clefts; cleft lip and palate each reported in 2/6. Helix shape alone does not establish ear dysfunction.
Congenital abnormal communication within the cardiovascular circulation.
Hereditary prostate cancer originates in a reproductive organ outside the axes; no other organ involvement is established.
Localized anterior staphyloma is a structural disorder of the eye.
IFNAR1 deficiency impairs antiviral immunity; reported vaccine infections do not establish common direct damage to another organ.
Neuropathy, nail dystrophy and ectropion each 30-79%; liver/spleen enlargement lacks established dysfunction; atherosclerosis is a separate disease.
Congenital cleft of the lip and/or palate directly affects oral anatomy.
Squamous carcinoma originates in the glottic larynx, which belongs to the airway axis.
The supplied definition explicitly describes neurodegenerative disease involving the eyelid.
Hereditary toe deformity with an annotated skeletal abnormality.
Combined immunodeficiency is defined by impaired immune function; no common additional organ damage is supplied.
Lethal brittle-bone disorder within osteogenesis imperfecta; insufficient evidence for direct damage to additional organs.
Immune-mediated necrotizing glomerulonephritis despite absent ANCA; extrarenal manifestations are less frequent and not established at 30%.
Neurodegeneration and photosensitive skin disease define the syndrome; sensorineural hearing loss in 4/4. Ocular telangiectasia lacks established functional damage.
Malignancy originates in the floor of the mouth, within the gastrointestinal axis.
Retinal degeneration, obesity/hypogonadism and digit malformations define the syndrome; intellectual disability 3/3. Hypodontia omitted under the four-axis cap.
Carcinoma originates in cutaneous eccrine sweat glands.
Contractures and developmental impairment define CLIFAHDD; chronic GI dysmotility/reflux in ~80%. Abnormal central breathing does not establish direct lung damage.
Immune-mediated inflammatory disease directly affects the intestine; no common additional organ damage is established.
Inherited LDL metabolism disorder; coronary atherosclerosis is a separate disease, and corneal arcus and xanthomas do not establish functional organ damage.
Progressive cerebellar and extrapyramidal dysfunction with cognitive impairment; abnormal eye movements reflect neurologic dysfunction rather than ocular damage.
Adrenal cortisol excess causes bone loss (~50-80%) and skin atrophy (~50%) in overt disease; subtype frequencies uncertain. Hypertension is separately diagnosed.
